name: Chaos Temple (Wilderness)
accessNote: The Chaos Temple in the low-level Wilderness (around level 11-13), north of the Goblin Village / west of the Dark Warriors' Fortress. Zombie pirates spawn here and count towards the Krystilia Pirates task; they are undead and weak to fire. Lower PKer risk than the Pirates' Hideout. Cannon and safespot are not wiki-documented here, so these are set conservatively to false.
